Owner's exact title: Not done: The Demo only row names only files whose names use letters, digits and the signs . _ / -, and says "and N other files" for the rest, so the row never holds a shell character.
The count uses only files returned by `_labelled`. At `src/forge/gaps.py:104`, `git ls-tree` quotes non-ASCII paths under its default settings, and `src/forge/gaps.py:67` passes those quoted strings as literal blob paths. A labelled file such as `café.tsx` is therefore omitted from the count; if it is the only labelled file, the entire gap disappears. [Git documents the default path quoting](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-config#Documentation/git-config.txt-corequotePath). Separately, line 48 suppresses the required `and N other files` text when every detected name is unsafe.
